title: Plugin-wide modularization backlog
purpose: Prevent future Elementor Implementation Toolkit work from entering oversized Admin, CPT, REST, Elementor, Support, JS, CSS, or script files.
objective: Keep authored plugin files in the 200 to 400 line range by giving every oversized domain a tracked split task and a reusable guard.
scope_boundary: In scope: inventory, line-budget guard, tracked transition debt, and split backlog for oversized authored plugin files. Out of scope: behavior-changing refactors, visual polish, new filter features, or rewriting the plugin.
entry_condition: DEC-EIT-015 is accepted and the plugin repo is clean before guard implementation.
exit_condition: The guard reports no untracked blocking debt and every current oversized file maps to a task or existing Filter Controller subplan.
completion_criteria: The inventory includes PHP, JS, and CSS authored files excluding vendor.
Current files above 400 lines are mapped to split tasks.
Files above 450 lines without a tracking task fail the line-budget guard.
Filter Controller work remains governed by TASK-FC-049 and TASK-FC-050.
Future feature work checks the destination file before editing.

phases.title: Inventory
phases.purpose: Record current source size by domain and risk bucket.

phases.title: Guard
phases.purpose: Make oversized-file drift reproducible through a local command.

phases.title: Critical splits
phases.purpose: Split files above 1200 lines before adding new complex work to those areas.

phases.title: High asset splits
phases.purpose: Split editor/frontend JavaScript and frontend CSS into bounded runtime modules.

phases.title: PHP support splits
phases.purpose: Split CPT, Support, ContentControls, test harness, and near-threshold REST surfaces.

acceptance_criteria: No new authored PHP/JS/CSS file above 450 lines can pass without a task ID.
No existing Elementor control ID, REST route, option name, CPT slug, or CSS selector is renamed during split-only tasks.
CSS and JS split tasks preserve load order unless a separate behavior decision is accepted.
Admin and asset monoliths are treated as product risk, not cosmetic cleanup.
verification: validate_task passes for TASK-018 through TASK-028 and TASK-FC-049.
stop_conditions: A new feature lands in a critical file before its split task starts.
A split changes saved option schemas, Elementor control IDs, REST route names, or public selectors without an explicit behavior decision.
A newly extracted module crosses 400 lines during the same task.
